Package tests

Class AdjustableClock

java.lang.Object
java.time.Clock
tests.AdjustableClock
All Implemented Interfaces:
InstantSource
public class AdjustableClock extends Clock

Title: AdjustableClock Class

Description: A clock for tests that stands still until a test moves it forward. The failed-attempt delay in TP3 Aspect 5 is measured in time, so the tests need to place the clock exactly one second before, at, and after the end of a delay without waiting in real time. This class satisfies the "controllable clock" that TP3 Testing Requirements.pdf (section 2.3) asks the implementation to support.
